title: DataerMC
description: Manager your minecraft server in Web
body:
DataerMC MVP v0.0.3

Attention: You must download FrontEnd Panel in link: https://github.com/snowball3605/DataerMC/releases/tag/v0.0.3

Features:
- Self-hosted web dashboard and backend
- Minecraft server status monitoring
- Player list and player moderation actions
- Ban and kick records
- Multi-server management
- Plugin token management
- Staff accounts, custom roles, and permissions
- Plugin list management
- Runtime plugin enable/disable where supported
- Restart-based plugin disable/enable by moving plugin jars
- Dark mode and language switching

![Panel](https://github.com/snowball3605/DataerMC/blob/main/image.png?raw=true)
![Panel 2](https://github.com/snowball3605/DataerMC/blob/main/image2.png?raw=true)![Panel 3](https://github.com/snowball3605/DataerMC/blob/main/image3.png?raw=true)

Notes:
- Some plugins may not support runtime enable/disable and may require a server restart.
- If the server cannot move a plugin jar while running, stop the server and apply the change again.
